en.暴雨中，黑松庄园的铁门从内侧打开。穿黑色大衣的Kael没有撑伞，他背后停着数辆狼: In the downpour, the iron gates of Blackpine Manor swing open from the inside. Kael, in a black coat, stands without an umbrella, several werewolf vehicles behind him. All you know is that your aunt just died and left you a manor; yet this man speaks your childhood nickname with perfect accuracy.
en.Rowan从暗处出现，手里拿着沾泥的庄园钥匙。: Rowan emerges from the shadows, holding the manor key caked in mud.
en.Rowan当众把钥匙放到地上，后退一步，不强迫你靠近。Kael不阻拦你自己捡。: Rowan sets the key on the ground in front of everyone and steps back, not forcing you to come closer. Kael doesn't stop you from picking it up yourself.
en.门廊里Kael的副手举枪命令你露出手腕验证月纹。Kael挡在枪口前，摘下象征权限: On the porch, Kael's second-in-command raises a gun and orders you to bare your wrist for the moon mark verification. Kael steps in front of the barrel, removes the black-silver insignia that symbolizes his authority, and places it on the ground: without your permission, no one inspects you.
en.守卫喊出你未公开的法律姓名，要求“签署接管授权”。Kael就把羊皮纸扯成两半。纸: The guard shouts your unpublished legal name and demands you "sign the takeover authorization." Kael tears the parchment in half. Your handwriting is already on it.

en.守卫指出违反议会令会冻结他的军权。: The guard points out that defying the council order will freeze his military authority.
en.Rowan从暴雨里递来姨母最后一封没寄出的信，封口刻着你小时候的小名。你不打开也: Rowan hands you your aunt's last unsent letter through the storm, the seal carved with your childhood nickname. You can take it without opening it; he doesn't ask for your trust.
en.书房灯突然自己亮起。Lucien站在一张摊开的旧星图旁，似乎已经等了很久。: The study lamp flickers on by itself. Lucien stands beside an unfurled old star chart, as if he's been waiting a long time.
en.墙上一面镜子闪出三个狼影，正中央是一只没有狼影的你。月井第一次轻声叫出玩家自定义: A mirror on the wall flashes with three wolf shadows, and in the center, a you with no wolf shadow. The Moonwell softly speaks the player's custom name for the first time.
en.玩家腕上出现一圈只有月光才能照出的银纹；书房玻璃写着：“THE OATH IS: Silver markings appear on your wrist, visible only under moonlight. On the study window glass, written in frost: "THE OATH IS A LIE."
en.Kael带你进入议会厅。长桌两侧是近百位成年族人。Evelyn要求你按旧礼向首领: Kael leads you into the Council Hall. Nearly a hundred adult pack members line both sides of the long table. Evelyn demands you bow to the Alpha according to the old rites.
en.Kael把首领席旁边的椅子推到你面前，自己站着。: Kael pulls out the chair beside the Alpha's seat for you and remains standing himself.
en.议会提案让你签署《月印监护令》，纸页上你的姓名已经被他人预填。Kael当众撕去“: The council proposes you sign the Moon Mark Guardianship Decree. Your name has already been pre-filled on the page by someone else. Kael tears out the "obey the Alpha" clause in front of everyone. The elders who support him walk out on the spot.
en.议会要求你从地上跪着穿过人群。年轻狼人Tessa抬起头，腿却仍在发抖。Kael没: The council demands you crawl on your knees through the crowd. Young wolf Tessa lifts her head, but her legs are still trembling. Kael doesn't say "kneel for her" — instead he walks to your side and sits down on the cold stone steps first.
en.你可要求他站起来、请Tessa起身、或公开宣读新规则。稍后她递上一枚被敲坏的族徽: You can demand he stand up, ask Tessa to rise, or publicly read the new rules aloud. Later she hands you a cracked pack emblem: only the "Chosen" are forced to kneel.
en.会议散场Rowan拦住你，不挡去路，指向树皮上的三个爪痕。: After the meeting, Rowan stops you — not blocking your path, but pointing to three claw marks on the tree bark.
en.Rowan带你看被掩埋的旧族碑；Lucien辨认出姨母名字旁的日期被改过，且真正: Rowan shows you a buried old pack monument. Lucien recognizes that the date beside your aunt's name has been altered, and the true oath has an extra unsigned witness.
en.Lucien展示一株遇到玩家掌心会发亮的夜铃花。: Lucien shows you a nightbell flower that glows when it touches your palm.
en.你触碰花瓣，花里投射出姨母声音：“Find the three seals.”: You touch the petals, and your aunt's voice projects from within the flower: "Find the three seals."
en.要Kael公开更改迎接仪式: Demand Kael publicly change the welcoming ceremony
en.跟Rowan追爪痕: Follow Rowan to track the claw marks
en.请Lucien教你控制月光: Ask Lucien to teach you to control moonlight
en.议会登记册赫然显示姨母二十六年前的签名——旁边是Kael已故母亲的名字。: The council registry clearly shows your aunt's signature from twenty-six years ago — right beside the name of Kael's late mother.
en.你选择以手指描摹、请Lucien读旧语、或将刻痕拓印；当刻痕发光时，众人听见姨母: You choose to trace it with your fingers, ask Lucien to read the old tongue, or take a rubbing of the marks; when the marks glow, everyone hears your aunt's voice from when she was young:
en.镜面跳出你未来向狼王屈膝的幻象，但Lucien立即说明它可能是伪造投影。: The mirror flashes a vision of you kneeling to the Wolf King in the future, but Lucien immediately explains it could be a forged projection.
en.Rowan教你辨别三种狼族脚印。一个看不见的人从森林抛出银箭，Rowan用手臂挡: Rowan teaches you to tell apart three kinds of wolf tracks. An unseen person throws a silver arrow from the forest, Rowan blocks it with his arm, immediately retreats to a safe distance, and waits for you to decide whether to stay or go.
en.Lucien第一次承认自己曾亲手复制过含有错误誓文的预言，因此负有责任；Rowa: Lucien admits for the first time that he once personally copied a prophecy containing a false oath, and therefore bears responsibility; Rowan traces the mark to prove the image was artificially forged.
en.三个人第一次和你共进晚餐。Kael说他派人调查银箭；Rowan坚持自己寻找射手；: The three of them have dinner with you for the first time. Kael says he sent people to investigate the silver arrow; Rowan insists on finding the shooter himself; Lucien pushes a bottle of styptic medicine over to Rowan.
en.让Kael负责公共安全: Put Kael in charge of public safety
en.和Rowan调查银箭: Investigate the silver arrow with Rowan
en.银箭箭尾刻着议会仓库的出入编号。: The tail of the silver arrow is engraved with an access number from the council warehouse.
en.Kael教年轻狼族控制变身时的恐惧。一名少年因银箭事件失控，Kael挡在你与少年: Kael teaches young wolves to control their fear during transformation. One boy loses control because of the silver arrow incident, and Kael stands between you and the boy, but does not order the boy to kneel.
en.训练场的银箭直冲玩家而来，Kael先推开新人再以自己肩膀挡箭；Rowan在屋顶截: The silver arrow on the training ground flies straight at the player. Kael pushes the newcomer aside first, then takes the arrow on his own shoulder; Rowan intercepts a second arrow from the rooftop. It shows this was not a random attack, but a carefully arranged two-layer sniper setup.
en.你与Rowan追踪箭尾来到悬崖。石壁塌落，他抓住你衣袖防止跌落，确认你站稳后立刻: You and Rowan follow the arrow's tail to the cliff. The stone wall collapses, and he grabs your sleeve to keep you from falling, then lets go at once after confirming you are steady on your feet.
en.他把自己被驱逐当天的追踪牌交给你，这是第一次主动公开过去。: He gives you the tracking badge from the day he was exiled, the first time he has willingly revealed his past.
en.一道银箭冲向你的肩侧。Kael并非凭空瞬移：他先听到绞盘声、推开你身后的木门，箭: A silver arrow shoots toward your side. Kael does not teleport out of nowhere: he first hears the winch, pushes open the wooden door behind you, and the arrow pierces his cuff and shoulder guard. You can choose to stop the bleeding yourself first, call a doctor, or chase after the fletching; all three rescue paths are completed with NPC assistance, avoiding the unreasonableness of making the player fight alone.
en.Mara拿出姨母遗嘱：庄园只属于你，狼群没有管理权。Kael当着Mara把西翼的: Mara produces your aunt's will: the estate belongs only to you, the pack has no management rights. In front of Mara, Kael hands you the key to the west wing and an expense ledger.
en.Kael把保险箱钥匙、园区通行码和财务权限放在桌上，承认他过去曾为了保护家族保留: Kael places the safe key, estate access codes, and financial permissions on the table, admitting he withheld information in the past to protect the family.
en.Kael打开家族保险盒，把能进入银箭仓库的总钥匙放到你面前，却故意把他自己那把折: Kael opens the family lockbox and sets the master key to the Silver Arrow warehouse before you, but deliberately snaps his own key in half.
en.他说明从今天起，任何新命令都必须经过公开复核。你可以接过钥匙、把钥匙交Mara共: He explains that from today on, any new order must go through public review. You can take the key, hand it to Mara for shared custody, or seal it away for now; refusing to touch it won't anger him. Rowan discovers a damaged receipt at the old pier that your aunt wrote to her sister Iris, with the Moonwell water level marked on the back.
en.木板下藏一只密封铁盒，里面是一张被撕掉一角的老照片：三枚狼印，原本属于三个不同族: A sealed iron box is hidden beneath the planks, containing an old photo with a torn corner: three wolf marks, originally belonging to three different packs.
en.Rowan让你看旧照背后被裁去的一角：Dorian当年的身形与银印一致。Luci: Rowan shows you the cropped corner on the back of the old photo: Dorian's build matches the silver mark. Lucien won't let you convict based on a photo alone and suggests finding the complete original.
en.Lucien对照照片指出一个不一致：预言书上写“Moonbound必须牺牲”，但: Comparing the photo, Lucien points out an inconsistency: the prophecy says "Moonbound must sacrifice," but the original oath was "decided by Moonbound."
en.与Kael一起公开账册: Make the ledger public with Kael
en.请Lucien复制原文: Ask Lucien to copy the original text
en.照片背面写着三个名字，其中一个被刮掉——Dorian。: Three names are written on the back of the photo, one scraped away—Dorian.
en.Lucien带你来到月井外围。水面映出狼印，偏偏玩家的名字是一片空白。: Lucien brings you to the edge of the Moonwell. Wolf marks reflect on the water's surface, but the player's name is a blank space.
en.月井映出你被迫戴上月印的未来，Kael的未来影像正强迫你签字。现实中的Kael毫: The Moonwell shows your future forced to bear the moon mark, with Kael's future image pressuring you to sign. The real Kael shatters the projection stone without hesitation, willing to let his pack see their leader defy the prophecy.
en.月井边的石碑依次显示三个狼印，随后出现你姨母的名字，却被一道黑色划痕覆盖。Luc: The stone tablet by the Moonwell displays three wolf marks in sequence, then your aunt's name appears, covered by a black scratch. Lucien reaches toward the tablet, then stops and asks you to decide.
en.帮Lucien逐页找改动: Help Lucien go page by page to find the changes
en.档案末尾写着“Eclipse Protocol, activation in t: At the end of the file it says "Eclipse Protocol, activation in twenty-four days."
en.Kael在族群议事会上承认自己曾签署封锁令，并要求审查Dorian当年的权限。: Kael admits at the pack council that he once signed the lockdown order, and demands a review of Dorian's authority at the time.
en.Kael主动在议会上公开承认自己签过不该签的封锁命令，并宣布自愿接受独立审查。支: Kael voluntarily confesses at the council that he signed a lockdown order he never should have, and announces he'll submit to an independent review. Two clan leaders who support him announce they're withdrawing their forces.
en.Kael在全族公开的审议会上承认自己曾签下银箭仓库的旧命令，即使那天他并不知道箭: Kael admits before the whole pack at the public tribunal that he signed the old order for the Silver Arrow warehouse, even though he didn't know that day the arrows would be used in an attack.
en.Dorian拿走他的部队调遣权。Kael没有当众向玩家索取拥抱，只看向你：: Dorian takes away his troop deployment authority. Kael doesn't ask you for a hug in front of everyone, he just looks at you:
en.Iris不愿见Kael。她先看向玩家。: Iris doesn't want to see Kael. She looks to you first.
en.Kael没有逼Iris原谅，只把公开承认错误的声明放在她门外。: Kael doesn't push Iris to forgive him. He just leaves the statement publicly admitting his mistake outside her door.
en.会后他独自坐在暗厅，问你是否愿意陪他坐五分钟，而不是讨一个吻。你拒绝也得到尊重。: After the meeting he sits alone in the dark hall and asks if you'd be willing to sit with him for five minutes, not asking for a kiss. If you refuse, he respects it.
en.陪Iris验证证据: Accompany Iris to verify the evidence
en.让Lucien检查印记副本: Have Lucien examine the copy of the mark
en.Dorian派人送来邀请，要求玩家午夜单独见面。: Dorian sends an invitation, asking you to meet him alone at midnight.
en.Kael因持续几夜处理族群骚动而失眠。你发现他把一封致亡母的信压在未寄出的信堆里: Kael hasn't slept for nights, dealing with unrest among the pack. You find a letter to his late mother buried in a stack of unsent letters.
en.他第一次承认自己也会恐惧。: He admitted for the first time that he gets scared too.
en.你可以留在医务室陪Kael，也可以跟Rowan追查箭羽，或向Lucien求证银箭: You can stay in the infirmary with Kael, go with Rowan to track the arrow fletching, or ask Lucien about the silver arrow materials. Kael won't blame you for leaving.
en.夜里Rowan来归还你遗落的手套。Kael正好开门。两人没有争吵，只把选择留给你: At night, Rowan comes to return the glove you left behind. Kael happens to open the door. The two don't argue—they just leave the choice to you.
en.请Kael陪你确认安全: Ask Kael to stay with you and confirm you're safe
en.请Rowan留下喝茶: Ask Rowan to stay for tea
en.追踪牌的驱逐时间，恰好与姨母失踪同一天。: The tracking card's expulsion time falls on the exact same day as your aunt's disappearance.
en.Mara指着姨母最后一张照片：那晚她没有逃离庄园，而是护送两名幼狼通过地下通道。: Mara points to your aunt's last photo: that night she didn't flee the estate—she escorted two wolf pups through the underground passage.
en.一张旧照片显示Kael签署封锁令时身旁站着Dorian，但时间戳与仓库日志冲突；: An old photo shows Dorian standing beside Kael when he signed the lockdown order, but the timestamp conflicts with the warehouse log; Kael admits he signed the order but denies ordering fire on civilians.
en.你发现一张“Rowan把姨母推向月井”的旧照。照片里真正的时间标记被剪掉。Row: You find an old photo of "Rowan pushing your aunt toward the Moonwell." The real time marker in the photo has been cut off. When Rowan sees it, he quickly turns away—he doesn't snatch the photo or ask you to believe him.
en.你可允许他解释、先查底片、或要求他在证据出来前保持距离。旧相片背面印着议会冲洗店: You can let him explain, investigate the negative first, or ask him to keep his distance until the evidence comes out. On the back of the old photo is a Council photo lab number, and Iris provides the record of when she personally bandaged your aunt's wrist.
en.Lucien找到同一晚的两份档案：官方记录称Iris盗取银印；私人信件显示是Do: Lucien finds two files from the same night: the official record claims Iris stole the silver seal; a private letter shows it was Dorian who ordered the passage sealed.
en.你发现姨母的第二张合照里出现一位未标注的女性守卫，她后来成了Evelyn的助手。: You discover a second group photo of your aunt featuring an unlabeled female guard who later became Evelyn's assistant. What's missing isn't evidence—it's a witness.
en.Kael看过记录后承认，他年轻时签过一份没有逐字核实的封锁执行令；这使他成为旧错: After reviewing the records, Kael admits that in his youth he signed a lockdown execution order without verifying it word for word; this makes him part of an old mistake.
en.要Kael向Iris亲口道歉: Have Kael apologize to Iris in person
en.Rowan发现袭击者路线与议会仓库连通。你不是他背后的“被保护者”，而是手持真正: Rowan discovers the attackers' route connects to the Council's warehouse. You're not the "protected one" behind him—you're the partner holding the real map.
en.在石阵作公开见证: Stand as a public witness at the stone circle
en.和Rowan从侧道截断袭击者: Cut off the attackers with Rowan via the side path
en.跟Lucien改写石阵算法: Rewrite the stone circle algorithm with Lucien
en.三个狼印在玩家掌心投射出一个新的名字：Dorian Ashford。: Three wolf marks project a new name onto your palm: Dorian Ashford.
en.Rowan带你看完整的山谷轮廓，指出森林之外通往海岸的公路。: Rowan shows you the full valley outline, pointing out the highway beyond the forest that leads to the coast.
en.你帮Rowan修一辆失修的摩托。他承认从没真正离开，因为妹妹还在山谷里。: You help Rowan fix a broken-down motorcycle. He admits he never really left, because his sister is still in the valley.
en.Rowan修好一辆旧摩托，将出谷路线和应急现金放在你掌心，明说即使你从此不回来也: Rowan fixes up an old motorcycle and places the route out of the valley and emergency cash in your palm, saying plainly he won't stop you even if you never come back.
en.Rowan展示一辆已经加满油的车、匿名现金和边境证件。他没要求你跟他走。: Rowan shows you a car with a full tank, anonymous cash, and border documents. He didn't ask you to come with him.
en.你问他是不是早就准备离开，他否认：: You ask if he'd been planning to leave all along. He denies it:
en.一辆议会巡逻车驶过，窗上反射出“Iris is alive”的涂鸦。回响：离开路: A Council patrol car drives past, its window reflecting graffiti that reads "Iris is alive." Echo: leaving route grants two exclusive border scenes, still able to return to the main story; stay→; investigate Iris→. No route auto-confirms a partner.
en.Lucien把一张预言空白页给你做笔记。: Lucien gives you a blank prophecy page to take notes on.
en.谷口的通行证突然全部失效——不是Rowan给的路线有问题，而是Dorian宣布“: All valley pass permits suddenly stop working—not because there's a problem with the route Rowan gave you, but because Dorian declared a "valley lockdown to protect the heir." Kael hands you his official passage seal to fight the blockade.
en.接受Rowan教你开山路: Accept Rowan teaching you mountain roads
en.让Kael安排山谷外的信息渠道: Have Kael set up an information channel outside the valley
en.与Lucien写下第一句新誓言: Write your first new vow with Lucien
en.医务室停电，Kael肩伤复发却仍怕在你面前显得软弱。: The infirmary lights go out. Kael's shoulder wound flares up, but he still can't stand the thought of looking weak in front of you.
en.Kael夜里因旧伤不能入睡。他告诉你，自己最怕的并非失去首领位置，而是习惯了命令: Kael can't sleep at night because of his old wound. He tells you his biggest fear isn't losing his position as leader—it's that after getting used to giving orders, he no longer knows how to honestly ask for company.
en.转场：雨声由室外强到室内弱，绝不突然放烟花。: Transition: rain fades from loud outside to soft inside—never cut to sudden fireworks.
en.Lucien带你看刻有姨母名字的石碑：她不是被选中的祭品，而是上一位推翻祭献的见: Lucien takes you to see the stone tablet carved with his aunt's name: she wasn't a chosen sacrifice—she was the witness who overturned the sacrifice before.
en.Lucien在湖边坦白每次预言都会失去一段自己的记忆：他忘记过妹妹生日，却记得第: Lucien confesses by the lake that every prophecy costs him a piece of his memory: he's forgotten his sister's birthday, yet he remembers the first time he heard your name. It's not destined love—it's that he chose to write you into his pocket journal.
en.Rowan送来一张手绘庄园地形图。[若，上面有: Rowan brings a hand-drawn map of the estate. [If, there's
en.询问Kael可以拥抱他吗: Ask Kael if you can hug him
en.邀请Rowan坐下画图: Invite Rowan to sit down and draw
en.与Lucien共同为姨母点灯: Light a candle for his aunt with Lucien
en.半夜，月井第一次发出像心跳一样的两声敲击。: At midnight, the Moonwell makes two knocking sounds like a heartbeat for the first time.
en.三枚石刻在月光下亮起，显示只有三枚狼印加上一位自由见证者，才能改变誓约。Dori: Three stone carvings light up under the moonlight, revealing that only three wolf marks plus one free witness can change the oath. Dorian's people try to block the outer passages.
en.石阵追兵到来，Rowan本能想把你藏到身后。你指出石阵第三入口并组织三人脱困，他: The stone circle's pursuers arrive, and Rowan instinctively tries to hide you behind him. You point out the third entrance and organize the three of you to escape. He starts calling you "Boss"—not treating you like prey to be tamed.
en.月石阵失稳，你和Rowan都被封锁在石环内。Rowan准备背你跳出去，你却发现刻: The moonstone circle destabilizes, and you and Rowan are both sealed inside the ring. Rowan prepares to carry you out, but you notice an old exit carved into the ground leading to a rescue zipline Iris set up. You choose to give orders, unlock it yourself, or sync up with Rowan.
en.他笑出声，第一次不把危险当成调情借口。: He laughs out loud—for the first time, not using danger as an excuse to flirt.
en.Kael在护送少年时被银刃擦伤。你走进医务室，他以为你会害怕。: Kael gets grazed by a silver blade while escorting the boy. You walk into the infirmary, and he thinks you'll be afraid.
en.Iris传来密信：当年指控她的人手里有月井控制器钥匙；Dorian控制的新守卫队: Iris sends a secret letter: the person who accused her back then holds the key to the Moonwell controller; Dorian's new guard squad has already started searching for her.
en.Lucien在玻璃穹顶向你展示两种结局：第一种他保留神谕权力但你被困；第二种他放: Lucien shows you two endings beneath the glass dome: in the first, he keeps the power of prophecy but you remain trapped; in the second, he gives up his foresight but no one can ever dictate your fate again. He burns the first prophecy in front of you.
en.Lucien让你看见两个未来：一条是你选择某人的伴侣契约，山谷暂时和平；另一条是: Lucien lets you see two futures: in one, you choose someone's mate bond and the valley knows temporary peace; in the other, you refuse the bond and the valley falls into brief chaos before finding a new order. He tells you the council recorded the first as the "only correct answer."
en.你让Lucien合上星图，第一次带他做一件不为预言服务的事：给新开的花取名字。: You have Lucien close the star chart and take him to do something that isn't in service of prophecy for the first time: naming a newly bloomed flower.
en.旧神谕书背页传来姨母录音：三枚狼印不是锁，第四枚人类印才是解锁权；只要不自愿，月: A recording of your aunt's voice comes from the back page of the old prophecy book: the three wolf marks aren't locks—the fourth, the human mark, is the key; as long as it isn't voluntary, the Moonwell has no right to bind you.
en.月井外保护符文一夜间松动。Lucien看到的是一千种灾难可能，但玩家在其中仍拥有: The protective runes outside the Moonwell loosened overnight. Lucien sees a thousand possible disasters, but you still have room to act within them.
en.握住Lucien的手，让他只看现在: Hold Lucien's hand and make him see only the present
en.让Kael组织撤离附近居民: Have Kael organize the evacuation of nearby residents
en.和Rowan找月井外墙裂缝: Search the Moonwell's outer wall for cracks with Rowan
en.Lucien低声说：“The eclipse isn't coming earl: Lucien whispers, "The eclipse isn't coming early. Someone moved the clock."
en.Iris登上公共平台展示原始封锁记录。: Iris takes the public platform to reveal the original lockdown records.
en.Iris走进议会公开展示她研发的银毒解药和被删除的医疗记录，明确她被驱逐是因为拒: Iris walks into the council and publicly presents the silver poison antidote she developed and the deleted medical records, making it clear she was banished for refusing to test the drug on Dorian. Rowan almost rushes forward, but his sister gently holds him back.
en.广场审判本想把Iris押上台认罪。你与Mara出示证据后，她不再躲在Rowan身: The square trial meant to drag Iris onto the stage to confess. After you and Mara present the evidence, she no longer hides behind Rowan and stands before the judgment seat herself.
en.Kael亲自向Iris道歉。: Kael apologizes to Iris in person.
en.你决定是否公开公布记录、先保护证人或先为受害者提供治疗，三条都可以恢复Iris的: You decide whether to publicly release the records, protect the witnesses first, or provide treatment to the victims first—all three can restore Iris's name.
en.Rowan在旧车座里找到一段姨母录音：“Dorian never intende: Rowan found a recording from your aunt in an old car seat: "Dorian never intended to end the eclipse."
en.月会前夕，Kael应邀出席慈善冬舞会。无数人向他邀舞，他却走到你面前，不抢你的手: On the eve of the Moon Assembly, Kael attends the charity winter ball as an invited guest. Countless people ask him to dance, but he walks over to you, doesn't grab your hand, just bends down to meet your eyes.
en.冬季舞会入口，Kael已失去军权，却拒绝让Dorian宣布你为他的未婚伴侣。他当: At the entrance to the winter ball, Kael has lost his military power, yet refuses to let Dorian announce you as his fiancée. In front of the entire hall, he hands you the "engagement announcement" to tear up yourself.
en.Dorian当众宣布Kael与贵族家族“政治订婚”，试图把你挤到宾客席。Kael: Dorian publicly announces Kael's "political engagement" to a noble family, trying to push you into the guest seats. Kael walks to the stage holding the unsigned marriage contract, tears it open in public, and admits it's not about fighting for ownership of you:
en.他走向你，缓缓停下。: He walks toward you and slowly stops.
en.与此同时窗边出现可疑脚印。参加/不参加均可发现袭击前兆。: Meanwhile, suspicious footprints appear by the window. Whether you attend or not, you can discover signs of the attack.
en.Rowan拒绝进入舞会，独自在河边教几个孩子折纸狼。你找来时，他笑着把其中一只递: Rowan refuses to enter the ball and teaches a few kids by the river to fold paper wolves alone. When you find him, he smiles and hands you one.
en.你可与一人共舞、单独与其他人聊天或不跳舞；舞曲高潮时灯光被人为切断，戴面具的刺客: You can dance with one person, chat alone with others, or not dance at all; at the climax of the dance, the lights are deliberately cut, and a masked assassin takes away an old witness.
en.Mara拿出姨母留下的舞会照片。照片后写着：“The night I chose: Mara brings out a ball photo your aunt left behind. On the back it says: "The night I chose mercy, Dorian chose power." Kael, Rowan, and Lucien all receive your discovery notification at the same time, and for the first time join forces to arrange witness protection.
en.陪Rowan在河边烤棉花糖: Roast marshmallows by the river with Rowan
en.留在照片墙调查: Stay at the photo wall to investigate
en.照片里站在Dorian身后的少年，竟然是十年前的Lucien。: The boy standing behind Dorian in the photo turns out to be Lucien from ten years ago.
en.Lucien承认小时候被Dorian囚在预言室，被迫阅读“谁该被牺牲”，是姨母把: Lucien admits that as a child he was locked in the prophecy room by Dorian, forced to read "who should be sacrificed," and it was your aunt who got him out.
en.Kael被公开质疑是否配做首领。你找到他时，他正在弹母亲教过的一段简单旋律。: Kael is publicly questioned whether he's fit to be leader. When you find him, he's playing a simple melody his mother taught him.
en.和Lucien核对公告背后的遗漏: Go over the omissions behind the announcement with Lucien
en.修正后的档案揭露：封井当天，Dorian携带的并非首领之印，而是一个复制品。: The corrected file reveals: on the day the well was sealed, Dorian wasn't carrying the leader's seal—but a replica.
en.Rowan告诉你一个难以启齿的事实：他曾接受Dorian的任务假意监视姨母，因为: Rowan tells you a hard-to-admit truth: he once took a job from Dorian to pretend to watch his aunt, because at the time Dorian threatened Iris's safety.
en.瞭望塔上Rowan承认，数年前他为了保护Iris曾被迫替Dorian监视姨母；姨: At the watchtower, Rowan admits that years ago, to protect Iris, he was forced to spy on his aunt for Dorian; the last time his aunt left the estate, he didn't report her escape route, but before that he had handed over a map.
en.Rowan承认曾受Dorian胁迫监视你姨母，曾递送一次错误的行动路线，导致她被: Rowan admits he was coerced by Dorian into spying on your aunt, and once passed along a false route that led to her capture by the council; he later turned back and rescued her, but he can't erase that first choice.
en.他把证人名字、时间和自己的犯罪记录交给你。: He gives you the witness's name, the time, and his own criminal record.
en.无论是否原谅，他都会交出原始地图。: Whether or not you forgive him, he'll hand over the original map.
en.Lucien说Rowan的记忆与旧档案一致，无法证明他从未说谎，却能证明他在关键: Lucien says Rowan's memory matches the old files—it can't prove he never lied, but it can prove he switched sides on the critical night.
en.Rowan把机车钥匙放在你面前，然后将手收回。: Rowan places the motorcycle keys in front of you, then pulls his hand back.
en.说出失望，要求Rowan不再隐瞒: Voice your disappointment and demand Rowan stop hiding things
en.愿意陪他重新走那条路: Willing to walk that road again with him
en.Rowan车库外出现涂有古狼纹的黑色车辆，来自Dorian私人卫队。: Outside Rowan's garage appears a black vehicle painted with the ancient wolf crest, from Dorian's private guard.
en.Lucien带你看当年预言室。无数镜子映出不同未来：你成为祭品、成为首领伴侣、独: Lucien takes you to the old prophecy chamber. Countless mirrors reflect different futures: you become a sacrifice, become the leader's consort, leave alone. But the mirrors don't show the path where you change the rules.
en.Lucien当着众人打碎预言镜，镜子背面露出Dorian的控制刻印——历代“命定: Lucien shatters the prophecy mirror in front of everyone. On the back is Dorian's control sigil—every generation's "destined mate" was just a manufactured political marriage mechanism. Evelyn wavers for the first time, but demands verifiable evidence.
en.预言镜显示你主动吻上三个男人中的一人，紧接着出现誓约签名。你发现自己的影像没有眨: The prophecy mirror shows you willingly kissing one of the three men, followed by a vow signature. You notice your reflection doesn't blink—it's a recorded playback. Lucien destroys the personal future files in the mirror right in front of you.
en.你可保存镜片、选择砸毁镜子、或先请Iris读取镜面银粉；三个方案都找到仪式造假链: You can save the mirror shards, choose to smash the mirror, or first ask Iris to read the silver powder on the surface; all three options uncover the ritual fraud chain, just with different forms of evidence. Echo: //.
en.Evelyn承认Dorian曾掌握预言室，却仍担心解除誓约会引发狼群失控。: Evelyn admits Dorian once controlled the prophecy chamber, but still worries that breaking the vow will cause the wolf pack to lose control.
en.你意识到必须拿出新的保护方案，而非仅揭穿谎言。: You realize you need to present a new protection plan, not just expose the lie.
en.Lucien教你把月井能量分成三路，避免被某一位首领垄断。: Lucien teaches you to split the Moonwell energy into three channels, preventing any one leader from monopolizing it.
en.让三位狼印持有者共同制定替代方案: Have all three wolf-mark bearers jointly create an alternative plan
en.镜面出现被藏的地图：月井真正的控制室就在庄园地下。: A hidden map appears on the mirror's surface: the Moonwell's true control room is beneath the estate.
en.Dorian的人切断庄园外电路。Kael冒雨检查撤离通道，回来时衬衫被雨淋透，手: Dorian's men cut the estate's external power. Kael checks the evacuation route in the rain, and when he returns his shirt is soaked through, but he's holding the diary you left on the terrace—he never opened it.
en.玻璃廊桥上Dorian的守卫封路，Kael被命令把你交出来恢复狼王之位。他把个人: Dorian's guards block the Glass Skybridge, and Kael is ordered to hand you over to restore his position as Wolf King. He throws his personal badge into the river in the storm, publicly refusing, and the guards' guns turn on him.
en.Dorian给Kael最后一次机会：交出你，恢复军权。Kael把自己的首领印戒放: Dorian gives Kael one last chance: hand you over, restore his military power. Kael places his leader's signet ring on the rain-washed stone railing, letting it roll into the drain.
en.他不看你是否感动，只站到枪口前：: He doesn't look to see if you're moved—he just stands in front of the guns:
en.代价真实执行：旧卫队离开、仓库权限冻结、Kael必须和普通人一起找避雨住所。你可: The cost is real: the old guard leaves, warehouse access is frozen, and Kael has to find shelter from the rain with ordinary people. You can take his hand, drape your coat over him, or keep your distance.
en.Rowan冒雨送来Dorian私人卫队的名单，摘下身上的短刀放到桌面，与玩家保持: Rowan braves the rain to deliver the list of Dorian's private guard, sets his knife on the table, and keeps his distance from you.
en.[若，他明确不邀请身体靠近：: [If he makes it clear he's not inviting physical closeness:
en.Rowan在雪中赶到交出武器，证明自己不是来绑架玩家。: Rowan arrives through the snow and hands over his weapon, proving he's not here to kidnap you.
en.停电后两人蜷缩在玻璃廊桥的暖灯旁。: After the blackout, the two of you curl up by the warm lights of the glass skybridge.
en.走向Kael并提出亲吻: Walk over to Kael and offer a kiss
en.在Rowan旁边坐下，只谈秘密: Sit beside Rowan and talk only about secrets
en.独自写日记，邀请Lucien通过灯火通话: Write in your diary alone and invite Lucien to talk through the lamplight
en.庄园地下传来三声重击，地图上从未标注的门自己打开。: Three heavy knocks echo from beneath the estate, and a door never marked on any map opens on its own.
en.地下门后隐藏着一台用银链固定的月井控制器。它持续抽取狼族情绪，在月蚀时汇成献祭能: Behind the underground door lies a moonwell controller bound in silver chains. It continuously drains the emotions of the wolf clan, pooling them into sacrificial energy at the eclipse.
en.月井响起一串“不要”，不是邪神诅咒，而是历代被迫缔约者留在井里的拒绝。玩家触摸第: The moonwell rings out a chorus of "don't"—not a dark god's curse, but the refusals left in the well by generations forced into pacts. After you touch the fourth seal, dozens of voices can be heard by everyone for the first time.
en.月井下传来成百上千个被迫缔约者的声音，不断重复“我当时拒绝了”。Lucien解释: Beneath the moonwell rise the voices of hundreds of people forced into pacts, repeating over and over, "I refused back then." Lucien explains that the old covenant doesn't just drain moon energy—it captures the lingering consciousness of every refuser and rewrites it into a history of "voluntary union." You can choose to publish anonymous testimony, prioritize identity protection, or find out whether the seal can be safely released. Mara pulls out her aunt's research page: "The well doesn't need love. It needs obedience disguised as love." The three male leads stop competing for your favor and start asking what resources you need. Interaction: listen to three voices and identify three emotions—used only to arrange testimony, does not affect the rescue.
en.Lucien被控制器诱发童年预言闪回，紧握手里的灯。你可以与他并肩呼吸，或保持距: Lucien is triggered by the controller into a childhood prophecy flashback, gripping his lamp tightly. You can breathe alongside him, or keep your distance and stay near.
en.[若，他先看向手掌再说：: [If he looks at his palm first, then speaks:
en.三位男主在不同入口保障你撤离，谁也不能代替你按下断链机关。Evelyn亲耳听见祖: The three male leads secure your escape at different entrances, but none of them can press the chain-breaker for you. Evelyn hears her grandmother's voice with her own ears and decides to grant you Oversight Bureau access.
en.你找到姨母写在门背的一句话：“A free witness can refuse: You find a line your aunt wrote on the back of the door: "A free witness can refuse the final command."
en.按照姨母提示切断抽取器: Cut the extractor as Auntie instructed
en.先撤离旁边被困的族人: Evacuate the trapped clan members nearby first
en.请Lucien读取故障后果: Ask Lucien to read the fault consequences
en.Dorian在通话中冷笑：“You've found the engine. Y: Dorian sneers over the call: "You've found the engine. You still haven't found the key."
en.玩家召开第一次联合会议。: The player convenes the first joint meeting.
en.你在地图室制定救人方案：Kael负责阻止原卫队、Rowan潜入第四门、Lucie: You lay out the rescue plan in the map room: Kael handles stopping the old guard, Rowan infiltrates the Fourth Gate, Lucien cuts the false prophecy broadcast. For the first time, the three don't fight over accompanying you—they respect your assignments.
en.你在地图上安排突破议会封锁的三路小队。Kael想保护你去最近安全区；Rowan想: You arrange three squads on the map to break through the Council's blockade. Kael wants to escort you to the nearest safe zone; Rowan wants to grab the evidence first; Lucien insists on sealing the Moonwell. As the three argue, you ring the silver bell on the table.
en.你决定公开计划吸引盟友，还是秘密行动保护证人；每种方式都有不同损失（公众误解 /: You decide whether to go public with the plan to attract allies, or act in secret to protect the witness; each path has different costs (public misunderstanding / more time consumed), and neither lets you win big without a price.
en.他们试着将三印同时接入石阵却发现缺少第四条人类见证指令。玩家腕上银纹充当通路，但: They try connecting all three seals to the stone circle at once, only to find the fourth human witness command is missing. The silver mark on the player's wrist serves as the conduit, but no blood or sacrifice is required.
en.建立三个族群共同议会: Establish a joint council of the three clans
en.暂时保留旧誓约但废除献祭: Temporarily keep the old oath but abolish the sacrifice
en.议会宣布将以“干扰月井”罪名公开审判Kael。: The Council announces Kael will face a public trial on charges of "interfering with the Moonwell."
en.月食前夕: On the eve of the lunar eclipse
en.Kael收到停职命令。为避免族人被拖入冲突，他主动把首领戒放到桌面。: Kael receives orders to stand down. To keep his clan from being dragged into the conflict, he places his chieftain's ring on the table himself.
en.Kael将首领戒放到公众席，要求独立调查；Dorian当场宣布对Kael的叛逆裁: Kael places the chieftain's ring in the public gallery and demands an independent investigation; Dorian immediately declares Kael in rebellion, forcing the wolf pack to choose sides between the old oath and public evidence.
en.Kael将象征血统继承的戒指放到议会面前。Dorian宣读剥夺宣言，威胁让其家族: Kael places the ring symbolizing his bloodline inheritance before the Council. Dorian reads the declaration of revocation and threatens to erase his family history. Kael doesn't ask for compensation on your behalf:
en.和Lucien一起守最后一盏灯: Guard the last lamp with Lucien
en.远处月井光柱冲天，Dorian宣称他已拿回“真正的第四印”。: In the distance, a pillar of light shoots up from the Moonwell. Dorian declares he has reclaimed the "true Fourth Seal."
en.Dorian试图借旧条款宣判Kael失去首领资格，并强迫你作为“月之所有物”接受: Dorian tries to use old clauses to strip Kael of his leadership and force you to accept the transfer as "property of the Moon."
en.你站起来，明确声明自己作为庄园继承人、事件见证人的独立地位。: You stand and clearly declare your independent status as heir to the estate and witness to the events.
en.Evelyn举行公开听证：Dorian用一份“姨母自愿交出四印”的录像反杀你们。: Evelyn holds a public hearing: Dorian counters with a video of "Aunt voluntarily surrendering the Four Seals."
en.你注意到录像中你的腕纹在镜子里出现在错误位置，少了八秒音轨。你可调用镜片、银箭账: You notice that in the video, your wrist mark appears in the wrong place in the mirror, and eight seconds of audio are missing. You can use the lens, the Silver Arrow ledger, Iris's witness statement, or Mara's saved notes—at least one piece of evidence can raise a basic challenge.
en.视觉：禁止使用不必要的人物受虐影像。: Visuals: No unnecessary depictions of character abuse.
en.Rowan负责护送证人跨过断桥，发现Dorian的人试图夺走Iris保存的原始文: Rowan is escorting the witness across the Broken Bridge when he discovers Dorian's people trying to seize the original documents Iris kept.
en.Kael作为证人承认自己有利于Dorian的旧签字，Rowan承认监视过姨母；两: Kael admits as a witness to his old signature that favored Dorian, and Rowan admits to surveilling Aunt; their confessions instead form a chain of evidence that cannot be bought.
en.Evelyn核验多份证据，承认旧誓约缺失自由见证者条款。: Evelyn verifies multiple pieces of evidence and acknowledges that the old oath is missing the free witness clause.
en.让Kael公开弃用强制服从条款: Have Kael publicly renounce the forced obedience clause
en.把证人保护权交给Iris: Give witness protection authority to Iris
en.让Evelyn宣布暂停所有祭献: Have Evelyn announce a suspension of all sacrifices
en.Dorian自称无需议会授权，月井控制器已经认他为主人。: Dorian claims he needs no council authorization—the Moonwell controller already recognizes him as master.
en.Rowan准备独自潜入Dorian据点。他提前告诉你计划，没有用“为你好”作为隐: Rowan prepares to infiltrate Dorian's stronghold alone. He tells you the plan in advance, without using "for your own good" as an excuse to hide it.
en.Rowan从Dorian旧仓库取出完整通行记录：当年Dorian亲自将复制印放进: Rowan retrieves the complete transit logs from Dorian's old warehouse: back then, Dorian personally placed the duplicate seal into the controller to frame Iris. Rowan is willing to include his own past mistakes in his testimony.
en.Rowan拿出隐藏档案，承认自己的过往监视，要求对自己同样调查；Lucien提交: Rowan brings out hidden files, admits to his past surveillance, and demands to be investigated as well; Lucien submits the mirror evidence but refuses to make an absolute prophecy that hasn't been verified.
en.Lucien将两份相互印证的档案交给Evelyn。她终于同意暂缓执行旧式月蚀献祭: Lucien hands Evelyn two sets of records that corroborate each other. She finally agrees to suspend the old eclipse sacrifice.
en.公开站在Kael身边，但不表态恋爱: Publicly stand by Kael, but don't declare it romantic
en.陪Rowan公开自认错误的证词: Accompany Rowan as he publicly admits his mistakes in testimony
en.提醒Evelyn必须保护证人: Remind Evelyn that she must protect the witnesses
en.Dorian发动私人卫队夺取月井，Evelyn的官方封锁令已来不及送达。: Dorian mobilizes his private guard to seize the Moonwell, and Evelyn's official lockdown order won't arrive in time.
en.红月提前升起。Lucien用月纹屏障保护避难所里的孩子，即使这会让他暂时失去预言: The red moon rises early. Lucien uses a moon-sigil barrier to protect the children in the shelter, even though it will temporarily cost him his prophetic ability.
en.红月夜难民营停电，Lucien用自己的记忆替孩童抵挡月井幻觉，醒来后竟忘记你们在: A power outage hits the Red Moon Night refugee camp. Lucien uses his own memories to shield the children from the Moonwell hallucinations, and when he wakes, he's forgotten what you said in the greenhouse. You can tell him again, or give him space.
en.Kael带着食物和担架；Rowan送来了救出的族人；Lucien整理伤者名字。三: Kael brings food and stretchers; Rowan sends rescued clan members; Lucien organizes the names of the wounded. For once, the three of them aren't competing over who is loved more—they're doing what you hoped they would.
en.月蚀前的灾民挤满走廊。三人各做不同的事：Kael给受伤孩子换药；Rowan将最后: Before the eclipse, disaster victims crowd the corridors. The three men each do something different: Kael changes bandages for an injured child; Rowan hands the last cart of food to Iris; Lucien, struggling with his lost memories, tries to write down the names of those in the shelter. No matter who you choose, the others keep working—they don't "disappear" just because the player didn't pick them. If you tend to Lucien, he opens a blank page with your name written on it:
en.Kael卸下指挥权却亲自搬医疗物资；Rowan把唯一可逃离的车辆交给Iris救伤: Kael steps down from command but personally hauls medical supplies; Rowan gives the only vehicle that could escape to Iris to save the wounded. At the ball's entrance, you watch the three men each make their own decision, none of them fighting to be the center of attention.
en.凌晨三人给你留出最安静的椅子。: At dawn, the three of them leave the quietest chair for you.
en.与Rowan去门前看雪: Go to the entrance with Rowan to watch the snow
en.Iris在药剂铺后厨房做了一桌失败的晚餐，Rowan紧张得不停擦已经干净的杯子。: Iris made a failed dinner in the back kitchen of the potion shop, while Rowan was so nervous he kept wiping an already clean cup.
en.陪Rowan走进市集: Walk into the market with Rowan
en.和Kael修最后一块路牌: Fix the last signpost with Kael
en.把避难所钥匙公开交给Mara保管: Publicly hand the shelter key to Mara for safekeeping
en.避难所墙壁显示控制器的停止口令缺一半，另一半藏在玩家姨母的日记里。: The shelter wall shows that half of the controller's stop phrase is missing, and the other half is hidden in the player's aunt's diary.
en.Lucien告诉你，月蚀即将到来，三人都愿陪伴，但关系选择可以等到危机结束。: Lucien tells you the lunar eclipse is coming soon. All three are willing to stay by your side, but the relationship choice can wait until the crisis is over.
en.观星台上三人各自表达想要留下，却不把爱情变成阻止你冒险的理由。Kael请你说出害: On the observatory, the three each express that they want to stay, but they do not turn love into a reason to stop you from taking risks. Kael asks you to say what you are afraid of, Rowan admits he wants to run away with you, and Lucien only says he hopes he can still hear your laugh tomorrow.
en.Mara拿出姨母最终录音。她说自己从未成为狼人，也从未与任何人缔结强制伴侣关系，: Mara brings out your aunt's final recording. She says she never became a werewolf, and never formed a forced mate bond with anyone, but she still changed the entire valley.
en.你发现姨母写给未来继承人的一张便签：“I hope you meet peopl: You find a note your aunt wrote to a future heir: “I hope you meet people worth choosing. More than that, I hope you learn that you can choose yourself.” What she left behind was not a marriage list, but a draft for building a public shelter in the valley.
en.你可以明确一段关系、选择暂不承诺或对他们说“我是为我自己去的”。: You can define a relationship, choose not to commit for now, or tell them, “I’m going for myself.”
en.玩家在无人催促的深夜写下自己的原则。这一段支持自由输入，会在结局和后日谈中逐字回: Late at night, with no one urging the player, they write down their own principles. This section supports free input, and it will be recalled word for word in the ending and epilogue. It does not force the user to disclose real-life private information.
en.保持独立且暂不恋爱: Stay independent and do not pursue romance for now
en.确认对某人有好感但不作承诺: Confirm you have feelings for someone but do not commit
en.录音最后传来停止口令：“The moon witnesses. It does: At the end of the recording, the stop phrase comes through: “The moon witnesses. It does not command.”
en.为关闭广播，Lucien当众撕毁自己保管的伪预言卷轴，月影能力瞬间熄灭。他惊慌地: To shut down the broadcast, Lucien publicly tears up the false prophecy scroll he was safeguarding, and his moonlight ability instantly goes dark. Panicked, he asks if you think it'll rain tomorrow, because for the first time, he can't see.
en.Lucien再也看不到未来，连走出门是否下雪都无法提前知道。他带了两双不同颜色的: Lucien can no longer see the future—he can't even know ahead of time whether it'll snow when he steps outside. He brought two pairs of gloves in different colors because he couldn't remember which one you like.
en.你可以陪他散步、告诉他只想做朋友、或帮助他建立儿童教育计划。: You can take a walk with him, tell him you just want to be friends, or help him build a children's education program.
en.回响：; 关闭后续默认情侣台词；开长期事业线。: Echo: ; Turn off default couple lines going forward; unlock long-term career route.
en.Lucien撕毁印有“你必属于某人”的私人神谕卷轴，公开声明预言不能当作契约。: Lucien tears up the private oracle scroll that reads "You belong to someone," publicly declaring that prophecy cannot be treated as a contract.
en.Rowan带你走向断桥，告知第四门已被守卫封死。他给你一条退路，并郑重承诺即使你: Rowan leads you to the broken bridge and tells you the fourth gate has been sealed by the guards. He gives you a way out and solemnly promises to support you even if you don't go with him.
en.Kael看见Rowan的潜入计划，只问你是否需要支援，而不把过去的争执带入执行。: Kael sees Rowan's infiltration plan and only asks if you need backup, without bringing past arguments into the operation.
en.请Rowan安全回来再谈感情: Ask Rowan to come back safe before talking about feelings
en.请Lucien保留属于自己的未来: Ask Lucien to keep a future that belongs to him
en.与Kael制定联合营救而非孤胆行动: Plan a joint rescue with Kael instead of going in alone
en.Rowan在Dorian据点找到一扇标着“Witness Zero”的门。: Rowan finds a door marked "Witness Zero" at Dorian's stronghold.
en.Iris带Rowan穿过曾经辱骂他的街道。市集上的人开始主动向他道歉，有人留下新: Iris takes Rowan through the streets where people once insulted him. At the market, people start apologizing to him on their own, and some leave fresh bread without forcing him to accept it right away.
en.Iris终于在归乡集市公开自己的名字，之前骂她叛徒的人来道歉；她不接受廉价道歉，: Iris finally says her name publicly at the Homecoming Market, and the people who once called her a traitor come to apologize; she refuses cheap apologies and demands a compensation system for all patients. Rowan sees her smile and says "home" out loud for the first time.
en.Kael与年轻族人亲自修复因封锁令损毁的村道，不再只是发布命令。: Kael personally repairs the village road damaged by the lockdown order with the younger clan members, no longer just issuing commands.
en.Iris将“Witness Zero”钥匙交给你，原来那道门最早为姨母准备，是保: Iris gives you the "Witness Zero" key. It turns out that door was originally prepared for her aunt—a sanctuary to protect free witnesses.
en.IF old_oath：你保留保护性结界，却删除任何关于强制伴侣、献祭与剥夺退出: IF old_oath: You keep the protective wards but strike every clause about forced mates, sacrifice, and removing the right to walk away, and establish a public review process.
en.IF seal_well：你与三男主协作将能量引入地下自然循环，关闭人造控制器并: IF seal_well: You work with the three male leads to channel the energy into the earth's natural cycle, shut down the artificial controller, and phase out the communities that depend on the Moonwell.
en.控制器碎裂，Dorian被Evelyn和族人依法拘押，明确保留后续审理，不安排私: The controller shatters. Dorian is lawfully detained by Evelyn and the pack, with a clear commitment to a later trial—no vigilante justice, no summary execution. You step back, and the three of them only approach once they're sure you want them to.
en.让Kael陪你在石阶坐下: Ask Kael to sit with you on the stone steps
en.先去找Rowan确认Iris安全: Go find Rowan first to make sure Iris is safe
en.请Lucien陪你看月亮恢复: Ask Lucien to watch the moon with you as it recovers
en.一轮真实的满月重新升起，但三位男主的狼印消失了——他们第一次不再受旧誓约驱使。: A true full moon rises again, but the three male leads' wolf marks are gone—for the first time, they're no longer bound by the old oath.
en.Kael带你看修复后的山谷，告诉你新议会正在选举首领。他可以参选，也可以不参选，: Kael takes you to see the restored valley and tells you the new council is electing a leader. He can run, or he can choose not to—for the first time, he doesn't need a marriage to secure power.
en.Kael弹完亡母教他的曲子。: Kael finishes playing the song his late mother taught him.
en.早晨Kael穿简单毛衣，手上有搬木头磨出的伤口。他问你想不想一起修庄园屋顶；过去: In the morning, Kael wears a simple sweater, his hands scraped from hauling wood. He asks if you want to fix the manor roof together; the man who was once served by the entire pack is learning to do ordinary things.
en.Kael在没有卫队的早餐桌上做糊了吐司。他坦白没做过如此普通的事。: Kael burns the toast at a breakfast table with no guards. He admits he's never done anything this ordinary.
en.你可逗他、为他重新烤、或只聊改革进展。: You can tease him, toast him a new slice, or just talk about how the reforms are going.
en.回响：取决于持续信任与玩家明确意向，不因早期未跳舞而失败。: Echo: depends on sustained trust and your clear intent—you won't fail just because you didn't dance with him early on.
en.Kael收到新议会的邀请，首次邀请你不是以“未来伴侣”身份，而是作为独立顾问。: Kael gets an invitation from the new council—and for the first time, he invites you not as a future mate, but as an independent advisor.
en.月食开始。Kael带主队守住北门，Rowan率领撤离者走林路，Lucien在石阵: The lunar eclipse begins. Kael leads the main force to hold the North Gate, Rowan guides the evacuees along the forest path, and Lucien carves the new oath into the stone circle. You hold the complete stop command.
en.Dorian释放旧的伪造证言，试图用“玩家害死过往见证人”的谎言动摇你。真实证据: Dorian releases old forged testimony, trying to shake you with the lie that "the player killed past witnesses." The real evidence shows your aunt died of natural illness, and she left you full choice.
en.圣坛上Dorian拿出“第四印授权书”，声称只要你亲吻某个狼印持有者就能停止月蚀: At the altar, Dorian produces the "Fourth Seal Authorization," claiming that if you kiss any wolf-mark holder, the eclipse will stop. Lucien points out this is a forged secondary bond: forcing public intimacy will feed the Moonwell again.
en.Dorian宣布：想要救山谷，必须当众选择一名狼族伴侣，并立即亲吻完成誓约。三名: Dorian announces: to save the valley, you must publicly choose a werewolf mate and kiss them immediately to complete the oath. The three male leads instantly realize: intimacy is being used as a key that can be forced.
en.假装同意不会强制发生亲吻；游戏进入破阵计时，不涉及对玩家身体的控制。: Pretending to agree will not force a kiss to happen; the game enters the formation-breaking countdown, with no control over the player's body.
en.三人分工阻挡守卫，Rowan取下自己的狼印制造通路。: The three split up to block the guards, and Rowan removes his own wolf mark to create a path.
en.你站在中央，三位男主分别在可见位置，不围堵、不触碰玩家。: You stand in the center, with the three male leads each in visible positions, not surrounding you or touching the player.
en.先稳定三枚狼印: Stabilize the three wolf marks first
en.Dorian启动“Witness Zero”旧代码，井水倒流，整个圣坛浮起。: Dorian activates the old "Witness Zero" code, the well water flows backward, and the entire altar rises.
en.Lucien发现真正指令：不是献祭，而是由自由见证者拒绝控制器，然后三枚印章共同: Lucien discovers the true command: it is not a sacrifice, but a free witness rejecting the controller, and then the three seals together redefine the flow of energy.
en.Dorian坦白自己篡改誓约是为了永远控制族群，但真正的月井并无独立恶意：它重复: Dorian confesses that he tampered with the oath to control the pack forever, but the true Moonwell has no independent malice: it repeatedly executes "oaths spoken under coercion," treating fear as authorization. You read the free retraction to the trapped consciousness, and the shackles in the well break one by one.
en.法阵要求你把掌心放上石台，你却发现真正的破解方式是让每一位狼印持有人自愿放弃对你: The formation requires you to place your palm on the stone platform, but you discover the true way to break it is for every wolf-mark holder to voluntarily give up their claim over you. Kael looks up:
en.Rowan把流亡印投入月井：: Rowan casts the Exile Mark into the Moonwell:
en.你需要选择制度结局：重建自由族群、封井休养、或建立议会监督的开放制度。游戏：三印: You need to choose the institutional ending: rebuild a free pack, seal the well and recover, or establish an open system overseen by a council. Gameplay: connect the three marks in a directed line, with prompts consistent with each person's independent goal; on failure, NPCs give verbal hints and you can retry/skip.
en.IF free_packs：你将三枚印章的能量分配给不同族群的公开议会，并加上可: IF free_packs: You distribute the energy of the three seals to a public council of different packs, and add a charter that allows exit and challenge.
en.开启, 后续关系仍可改变。: Turned on — you can still change the relationship later.
en.你可以用自己的话回应，也可以先听下去。: You can respond in your own words, or keep listening for now.
en.按自己的意愿作出选择。: Make the choice that feels right to you.
en.你想怎么做？: What do you want to do?
en.凯尔 · 没有王冠的日常: Kyle · Everyday Life Without a Crown
en.罗文 · 归途与远方: Rowan · The Road Home and Distant Places
en.继续探索，不急于承诺: Keep exploring, no rush to commit
en.接触只在双方愿意时发生，也可以拒绝。: Physical contact only happens when both sides are willing, and you can also decline.
en.跳过，不影响主线: Skip, won't affect the main story
en.共同居住也需要你另作决定。: Living together also requires a separate decision from you.
en.先从早餐和相处开始: Start with breakfast and spending time together
en.愿意讨论共同居住，不等于已经搬入: Being open to discussing living together doesn't mean you've already moved in
en.你为新月取的名字：: The name you gave the new moon:
en.第一轮自由之月: The First Round of the Free Moon
en.给未来自己的话: A message to your future self
en.给归乡的人留言: Leave a message for the one returning home
en.让选择进入真实的日常。: Let your choices carry into everyday life.
en.主线结束后的第一周: Week one after the main story ends
en.你想进一步了解谁？这不构成关系承诺。: Who would you like to get to know better? This doesn't constitute a relationship commitment.
en.制度与关系已经各自作出选择。你可以继续日常，也可以休息或只保持友谊。: The system and the relationship have each made their choice. You can keep up your routine, take a break, or just stay friends.
en.Rowan修好机车，告诉你他可以离开山谷，但第一次觉得回家和上路都不是惩罚。: Rowan fixes up the motorcycle and tells you he could leave the valley, but for the first time, going home and hitting the road both feel like something other than punishment.
en.Rowan在公路边把机车钥匙放到你掌心，另一只手拿着Iris写来的晚餐邀请。他第: Rowan places the motorcycle key in your palm by the side of the highway, his other hand holding a dinner invitation from Iris. For the first time, he has both the road and a home—and he doesn't need to run to prove he's free.
en.Iris把Rowan的旧追踪牌改造成一枚钥匙扣，提醒他哥哥身份不必等于永远牺牲。: Iris turns Rowan's old tracking tag into a keychain, a reminder that being a brother doesn't have to mean sacrificing yourself forever.
en.Rowan将去北方调查剩余流亡者。他不把自己留在山谷当成表忠心。: Rowan is heading north to investigate the remaining exiles. He's not treating staying in the valley as a loyalty test.
en.Rowan靠在机车旁，不再藏在玩笑背后。: Rowan leans against his motorcycle, no longer hiding behind jokes.
en.选择和Rowan共同探索未来: Choose to explore the future together with Rowan
en.请他先独自走一次: Ask him to go alone first
en.Rowan把头盔递给你，问：“Want to choose the next s: Rowan hands you the helmet and asks, "Want to choose the next stop?"
en.月井恢复自然循环后，Lucien失去了预知他人命运的能力，却仍能感受月亮与植物的: After the moon well returns to its natural cycle, Lucien loses his ability to foresee others' fates, but he can still sense the changes in the moon and plants. He's learning to care for a new seedling.
en.Lucien拿出手账，逐页给你看他失去能力后自己记录的快乐：烤坏的饼干、听错的歌: Lucien pulls out his journal and shows you page by page the joys he's recorded since losing his ability: burnt cookies, misheard songs, the night you laughed for a long time.
en.Lucien为你保留一页空白星图：不是写你的命运，而是供你们记录共同经过的夜晚。: Lucien saves a blank star chart for you: not to write your fate, but for the two of you to record the nights you've spent together.
en.Lucien在笔记本上写下“Tomorrow: unknown”。他从前害怕未知: Lucien writes "Tomorrow: unknown" in his notebook. He used to fear the unknown; now he's the one inviting you to a children's astronomy class.
en.回响：以同意和信任判断；影响后日谈；不允许突然恢复预言超能力。: Echo: Judge by consent and trust; affects the epilogue; no sudden return of prophetic powers allowed.
en.所有路线都明确他已经失去预言，不能在结局突然“看见未来”。: All routes make it clear he's lost his foresight—no sudden "seeing the future" in the ending.
en.Lucien缓慢、明确地说出喜欢。: Lucien says he likes you slowly and clearly.
en.愿意与Lucien一起创造新未来: Willing to build a new future with Lucien
en.先独自探索新世界: Explore the new world on your own first
en.新月来临，庄园庭院里三枚狼印一夜间开出三朵不同颜色的花。: When the new moon arrives, three wolf marks in the manor courtyard bloom overnight into three flowers of different colors.
en.庄园重新开放。Iris负责新族群的开放档案馆，Evelyn推动法律修订，Mara: The manor reopens. Iris runs the open archive for the new pack, Evelyn pushes for legal reform, and Mara turns her aunt's old study into a space where any pack member can seek refuge. The three male leads are no longer bound by the wolf marks, and the player is no longer "the pack's answer."
en.三个男人分别在庭院不同位置等待：Kael在花树下，Rowan在机车旁，Lucie: The three men wait in different spots around the courtyard: Kael under the flowering tree, Rowan by his motorcycle, Lucien at the greenhouse door. No one competes to speak first, and no one uses past rescues to claim your feelings. The screen shows "Who do you want beside you?" along with "Choose yourself / Keep exploring."
en.庭院庆典上，三人没有站成排列式男友选择菜单，而是各自正在做自己的事：Kael修园: At the courtyard celebration, the three men aren't lined up like a boyfriend selection menu—each is doing his own thing: Kael fixing the garden platform, Rowan helping Iris unload supplies, Lucien telling the kids constellation stories with no prophecies.
en.Iris的药剂室开门、Mara修好姨母的旧书房、Evelyn推行公开档案。Kae: Iris's apothecary opens, Mara repairs her aunt's old study, and Evelyn pushes for public archives. Kael, Rowan, and Lucien are each at work, not standing in a row like items waiting to be chosen.
en.继续相处，不急着决定: Keep spending time together, no rush to decide
en.Kael没有把首领戒送你，反而拿出一把庄园旁小屋的新钥匙，问你愿不愿一起为这栋房: Kael doesn't give you the alpha ring. Instead, he holds out a new key to a cottage by the manor and asks if you'd like to pick out curtains for the place together.
en.开启，每周有家庭、议会、磨合与支持事件。: Unlocks weekly events for family, council, growing pains, and support.
en.Rowan递给你一张空白地图而不是单程票。: Rowan hands you a blank map instead of a one-way ticket.
en.Iris留言：“Bring him back for dinner.” 开启，旅: Iris leaves a message: "Bring him back for dinner." Unlocks, with journey and homecoming side by side.
en.Lucien将曾用于写预言的本子改成你们的共同手账。: Lucien turns the notebook he once used for prophecies into a shared journal for the two of you.
en.开启，共同创作、天象观察与信任事件。: Unlocks events for creating together, stargazing, and building trust.
en.你将姨母的庄园变成不分狼族与人类的自由庇护所。三人各自拥有独立生活与友情，不给玩: You turn your aunt's manor into a free sanctuary for both wolves and humans. Each of the three men has his own independent life and friendships, and there's no "lonely failure ending" for the player.
en.开启，友谊、事业、世界治理与未来可选恋爱。: Unlocks friendship, career, world governance, and optional future romance.
en.剧本资源加载失败，请重试。: Failed to load story resources. Please try again.
en.继续了解: Keep getting to know each other
en.先修复信任，暂不确认恋爱: Rebuild trust first, hold off on confirming the relationship
en.我愿意继续了解你，但现在不承诺恋爱。: I'd like to keep getting to know you, but I'm not ready to commit to a relationship right now.
en.工作人员把从排水沟取回的戒指放入证物盘。它不再授予凯尔指挥权。Kael收到停职命: The staff places the ring recovered from the drain onto the evidence tray. It no longer grants Kael command. Kael receives orders of suspension. To keep his people from being dragged into the conflict, he voluntarily places the chief's ring on the table.
en.一道银箭冲向你的肩侧。Kael并非凭空瞬移：他先听到绞盘声、推开你身后的木门，箭: A silver arrow streaks toward your shoulder. Kael doesn't teleport out of thin air: he hears the winch first, shoves open the wooden door behind you, and the arrow pierces through his cuff and shoulder guard.
en.一辆议会巡逻车驶过，窗上反射出“Iris is alive”的涂鸦。: A council patrol car drives past, and the graffiti "Iris is alive" reflects in its window.
en.你可保存镜片、选择砸毁镜子、或先请Iris读取镜面银粉；三个方案都找到仪式造假链: You can save the lens, choose to smash the mirror, or first ask Iris to read the silver powder on the mirror's surface; all three options uncover the ritual forgery chain, just with different forms of evidence.
en.月井下传来成百上千个被迫缔约者的声音，不断重复“我当时拒绝了”。Lucien解释: From beneath the moonwell rise the voices of hundreds of thousands forced into pacts, endlessly repeating "I refused back then." Lucien explains that the old oath doesn't just drain moon power—it captures the residual consciousness of every refuser, rewriting it into a history of "voluntary union." You can choose to publicize the anonymous testimonies, prioritize identity protection first, or investigate whether the seal can be safely lifted. Mara pulls out her aunt's research page: "The well doesn't need love. It needs obedience disguised as love." The three male leads stop competing for your favor and start asking what resources you need.
en.你需要选择制度结局：重建自由族群、封井休养、或建立议会监督的开放制度。: You need to choose the institutional ending: rebuild a free clan, seal the well and rest, or establish an open system overseen by the council.
en.给未来自己的话：: A note to your future self:
en.Lucien拿出手账，逐页给你看他失去能力后自己记录的快乐：烤坏的饼干、听错的歌: Lucien takes out his journal and shows you page by page the joys he recorded after losing his powers: burnt cookies, misheard songs, and everyday moments he invites you to verify.
